description: One source of a project (see list_sources), with its journal: every change of how far it is checked — from what, to what, who and why — newest first, and when it was created and edited. Name it by 'id', or by 'project' and 'source' — its key, or any identifier it has in any shape: 'arXiv:2301.01234', a DOI or its https://doi.org/ address, 'MR1234567', 'Zbl 1234.56789', an ISBN. Anybody who sees the project.

id.description: The source's id, as list_sources returned it.

source.description: Its key ('IMP26') or an identifier it has, with 'project'.
